scope: Chess taxonomy and targeted matched-prefix cross-model feasibility. Full original M3 also needs additional task families and broader model-owned trajectories.

candidate_model.thinking: manual enabled; proposed 4096 thinking budget, max output 16000; settings must be fixed and tested before inference

budget.excludes: Taxes, new task-family collection, full original cross-family M3, and M4 training/evaluation

inference_rules: Pilot samples excluded from fresh confirmation labels.
Freeze the confirmation sample counts and analysis after the technical/cost pilot, before confirmation outcomes.
Shared-prefix results are conditional on Haiku 5.5 generated histories and original replies.
Different thinking implementations are recorded as model-policy differences.
Compare gain differences with uncertainty; significance in one model and nonsignificance in another is not evidence of a difference.
All floor/ceiling and unresolved results remain explicit.
Stop at a stage boundary for user review before further paid phases.
implementation_findings: vendor/pr917/caaf_agent.py fork overrides the configured model with the checkpoint model; an explicit audited transfer fork is required.
scripts/run_validation_stage.py and m2_runtime/budget.py are model-specific to M2; use a new versioned model-aware guard without editing frozen M2.
Capture actual response model IDs, usage, maximum liabilities, exact prefix/environment hashes and restore counters.
